author: Конрад Аденауэр / правительство ФРГ

results.1955: Defence statutes and voluntary cadre approved conditionally after ally status change, military ministry and early cadre; later constitutional article 87a process
results.military_budget_judgment: 2.000bn G$ earmarked within canonical FRG defense 22.97879167bn G$ for initial Bundeswehr development; incremental defense budget 0. Future force and procurement conditional.

results.1955: Parliament discusses wage-index principle, but August 1955 law and pension increases delayed due to very large additional social-insurance contributions falling on employers and employees, plus fiscal cofinancing concerns. No full formula adoption in 1955.
results.political_opposition: Employer associations, Economics Minister Erhard and Finance Minister Schaeffer urge revised contribution rates, tenure-based formula and transition

results.1955: Child allowance expansion receives CDU support; package second child, 500 DM one-time and 50 DM monthly under age three requires budget and fund agreement; no entire schedule instant
Legal funding and state program supported, actual contracts and outputs staged; 40% repayment as future lending obligations

fiscal.note: Defense 2bn inside baseline, not added or refunded. Industry 4bn modeled additional, subject to overlap check with existing 28.72348959bn economy. Pension delayed, no new 1955 pension outlay.

international_constraints: Sovereignty and alliance status from Paris Treaties must be adjudicated in world; NATO/WEU alignment as historical candidate, not copied mechanically
Saar compromise is pending FRG player response and bilateral negotiations, not automated annexation
BND source kept in separately restricted file and must not be revealed in public dossiers

pension_scenario_estimate.description: Assumes 65% represents mean payment across all pension recipients (high-cost interpretation), while a full-career standard worker pension formula would be cheaper.
pension_scenario_estimate.main_caveat: This is a high-cost pension-only consistent comparison; the source series refer to different benefit groups and estimates are not certified; do not infer a firm 1955 payroll tax rate from the aggregate ratio.
pension_scenario_estimate.contribution_method: Like-for-like pension-payment incremental funding: baseline historical 5.94bn DM payments = 2.4828bn DM federal funding (assumed 41.8%) + 3.4572bn DM employer/employee funding; hypothetical new 16.5711bn DM = 4.1428bn DM federal (25%) + 12.4283bn DM employer/employee (75%); increase 8.9711bn DM employer/employee = 31.28bn model G$, split in half = 15.64bn G$ extra for employers. This coherent accounting displaces earlier 18.44/9.22 numbers made by mixing whole-system contributions with pension-only benefits.
